ops.body: - **On a phone, deriving streets and analysing an area run as one block on the JS thread** (performance review, Nov 18): native has no worker (`landing/runOffPage.ts`), and `computeReadPaced` yields only between tiles and stages, so `deriveSegments`' junction and pair loops and the sidewalk merge (`streets.ts`), and `analyzeArea`, each run whole: about 1.7 s of deriving at 4x CPU on a dense read (landing.md). Yield every ~16 ms inside those loops with the same output (no `STREET_CODE` bump); measure on a device. A slice, not a fix.

- **`snapWalk` samples every cached piece in the walk's box, not only those near the trace** (performance review, Nov 18): `getSegmentsIn(walkBounds)` then every 5 m of each piece (`snapper.ts`); a long or diagonal walk pulls in tens of thousands of pieces whose cells the trace never touches. Skip a piece whose box meets no trace cell, provided the credits come out the same (else it is a snapping rule: `SNAP_RULES`).
